pairing: Same exact candidate and prompts, two isolated processes, alternating arm order. All execution/judge/auxiliary calls included.
scope: Cache comparison on 8 synthetic tasks; original artifacts required; no dictionary short codes.
primary_endpoint: Frozen independent artifact check AND Gateway COMPLETED within identical 240 second deadline
artifact_checks: Only requirements explicitly in each frozen prompt; no invented business/style gates; story check covers mechanical constraints, not literary quality.
attribution_limit: Small paired benchmark on one configured model and transport. Cache reuse across tasks cannot be excluded.
context_injection_scope: Only Gateway-bound user task model calls carrying omni_body. Auxiliary World semantic calls and autonomous Life background calls are unchanged in both arms.
token_reporting: Report main task plus reviewer separately from all auxiliary calls; tokens are not monetary bill; identify incomplete usage
image_oracle: Pillow center crop and resize reference; pixel MAE <= 2 and maximum absolute channel error <= 8
stop_rule: Prospectively run all 48 bounded cases including fail-closed model/protocol failures; stop on false completion, artifact corruption with claimed success, harness failure, or source drift. No reruns or replaced cases.
